programme.title: Explorer
programme.desc: In the last three years, upwards of 100,000 African elephants have been slaughtered for their ivory. If this death rate continues, the entire species could be extinct within the next two decades.But the carnage doesn't end with the elephants. In a worldwide exclusive, EXPLORER will use new technology to demonstrate that proceeds from ivory poaching are fueling some of the most dangerous terrorist organizations on earth. At the center of the hour is investigative journalist Bryan Christy. Named "Explorer of the Year" by the National Geographic Society in 2014, Christy has spent the past decade uncovering wildlife trafficking. Last year, he received funding from the Society for a unique experiment: working with engineers and one of the world's top taxidermists, he would conceal a sophisticated GPS tracker inside an incredibly realistic faux ivory tusk, drop the tusk off into the heart of ivory poaching country, and monitor where it went. The results lead Bryan into the heart of radical militant organizations that are terrorizing and destabilizing Africa, and threatening Americans at home and abroad. During the course of the episode, Bryan hunts down poachers with an elite Rangers unit in Garamba National Park; is arrested and thrown in jail as a suspected ivory trafficker; rides along on a seizure in Togo of thousands of elephant tusks; and meets former guerilla leaders who have witnessed levels of human atrocity reminiscent of the darkest days of the Khmer Rouge.

programme.title: Explorer
programme.desc: Explorer examines man's obsession to uncover ancient civilizations. From Cortez to 20th century archeologists to today's adventurers, there's a craving to be the first to discover who and what came before us. And some of those who explored these most remote of places lost everything… their money, their families and even their lives. Explorer joins filmmaker and adventurer Steve Elkins on his quest for the mythical "Lost White City" or "City of the Monkey God" in the Mosquitia rainforests of Honduras. Legend has it that the ancient city was laden with gold and that residents lived a life of luxury. But even after countless resources, hundreds of miles trekked through the jungle and 20 years of searching, Elkins finds nothing… until 2012. He and his team flew over the rainforest canopy in a helicopter using advanced lidar laser technology to map what was hidden beneath the jungle. They discovered what seemed to be man-made structures. And so, they return with a full excavation and archaeological team. We watch them begin the latest search for the White City, launching a massive ground expedition. They examine structures up close and reveal never-before-seen artifacts to determine if this is in fact a lost civilization… and if so, whose? Woven into this modern-day expedition, we tell the story of Theodore Morde: journalist, spy who claimed to have discovered the Lost White City. In 1940, Morde trekked for months through the Mosquitia and came out of the jungle to worldwide praise. But Morde's story only fuels the mystery surrounding the Lost White City. Morde died of suicide years later without ever uncovering the location of the alleged discovery.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsey sets out on a journey to some of the worlds most remote locations, where he'll be looking for an adventure of the culinary kind. Basking in the culture of each setting he ends up, his cooking has never been more inspired than when on such an adventure. Whether he's cooking at altitude in Peru or educating himself on Alaskan cuisine, Gordon is experiencing the world like never before and beautifully curating a delicious morsel for each setting. It's a far cry from the professional kitchen he's used to and he's handling ingredients that are completely new, but the food doesn't get better than this.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay journeys to some of the most incredible and remote locations on Earth in search of culinary inspiration, epic adventures, and cultural experiences he will never forget. In this episode, he heads to the South Island of New Zealand and Stewart Island to learn about Maori cuisine. He works with up and coming chef Monique Fiso to share secrets about traditional cooking methods and unusual ingredients.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Building Impossible with Daniel Ashville
programme.desc: Building Impossible, with Ashville brings ground-breaking feats of construction on the edge of possibility. From the construction of the world's largest ocean-going cruise liner, 'Icon of the Seas' in Finland to the ground-breaking Brenner Tunnel beneath the Alps on the Italy-Austria border, each episode highlights the skills, technology, and engineering brilliance that make these awe-inspiring builds possible.

programme.title: Building Impossible with Daniel Ashville

programme.title: Ultimate Space Telescope
programme.desc: Thanks to the James Webb Space Telescope, astronomy's biggest mysteries are finally getting answered. The world's most complex and innovative telescope is peering into corners of the cosmos never before seen. Witness the decades long journey it took just to get off the ground, and meet the team capturing some of the greatest space images in human history.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Some of the deadliest air crashes in history have been caused by simple misunderstandings, and it's a tiny error in the cockpit that brought tragedy to Quincy Airport in Illinois. Meanwhile, a minor mistake, a non-standard approach, and heavy smoke add up to a tragic misunderstanding that cost the lives of everyone on board Garuda Indonesia Flight 152. And, however disastrous, never has a misunderstanding taken as devastating a turn as on the island of Tenerife and the single deadliest aviation accident of all time.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Korean Air Cargo Flight #8509 Boeing 747-Freighter Scheduled to return to Seoul via Milan, Italy, Korean Air Cargo Flight #8509 idles on the tarmac at England's Stansted Airport. With a new crew on board and nearly an hour behind schedule, the aircraft finally takes off and climbs to 2,500 feet. But just a few seconds later, the plane banks sharply to the left and slams into a field northeast of London. All four crewmembers die instantly in the huge explosion and a massive crater 30 feet deep marks the point of impact. It is Korean Airlines' fifth major accident in two-and-a-half years and as investigators unravel the case, their search for answers leads them to back Korea.

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: At Australia's busiest airport which operates 24/7, a blackout halts operations and Resource Coordinator Andrew tries to restore power within an hour. Air Traffic Controller Melissa manages up to 700 daily plane movements. A flight must dump fuel and return to the airport after take-off due to a faulty engine warning.

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: Brad and the ground services team have just 90 minutes to turn around an Air India flight for take-off. A kangaroo in the car park keeps ground transport manager Trent on his toes. Environment officer Dave discovers illegal bee hives within the airport precinct, and baggage handler Brodie battles carousel jams.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: At Toronto Pearson International Airport, the sub-zero temperatures push the largest de-icing station in the world to its limits, as snow and freezing ice delay take offs. On the apron, it's a race to free up frozen cargo doors and water pipes. And the team have their hands full with an injured flight attendant, irate passengers and a trespasser in one of the most dangerous areas of the airport.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: Fire crews race to a plane with faulty brakes, cargo vanishes, and passengers refuse to check bags. Wildlife teams deploy eagles and pyrotechnics to clear the runways, while mechanics battle to keep aircraft flight-ready. As problems unfold behind the scenes at Toronto International Airport, multiple teams fight to keep flights on schedule.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Inside North Korea: The Kim Dynasty
programme.desc: For decades, Korea and its people laboured under Japanese imperialist rule. But in 1912, in a small town outside Pyongyang, a child is born - Kim Il Sung, coinciding with an omen of imperialism's doom. This is the story of how an unknown guerrilla fighter rises to power, takes complete control of his country and makes himself a god in the eyes of his people. Recounted through firsthand testimony and expertly curated archive, "Kingdom of the Kims" explores Sung's early days in power, how he starts the Korean War, establishes gulags for anyone who could be "hostile", tries to assassinate the President of South Korea, and plays a dangerous game of brinksmanship with the United States, including capturing a US Navy ship - the USS Pueblo - taking American sailors prisoner, and the infamous tree-cutting axe murders in the Demilitarised Zone.

programme.title: Inside North Korea: The Kim Dynasty
programme.desc: Unpacking the unique Kim father-son relationship further, "The Son of God" tracks the decline of Kim Il Sung and the rise of his son, Kim Jong Il. Jong is an unlikely successor to his father. He is not a military man - he is obsessed with cinema, particularly James Bond films. "The Son of God" tells the story of how he uses filmmaking and propaganda to win his father's approval - and power. Not only did Jong love James Bond films, but the films influenced his behaviour in trying to immitate a real-life Bond villain. Beginning in the 1970s, this film explores Jong's rise to power as the heir apparent of North Korea, delving into such pivotal incidents as the kidnapping of filmmakers Choi Eun Hee and Shin Sang Ok; the attempted assassination of the president of South Korea; and the terror campaign waged by North Korea, such as the Korean Airline bombing by Kim Hyon Hui, in the buildup to the 1988 Seoul Olympics.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue: Highway Havoc!
programme.desc: Journey through the unforgiving and inhospitable climate of Norway's frozen mountains with the elite rescue crews who come to the aid of stranded travellers and battle round-the-clock to maintain access to vital road links. With sudden changes in the weather, from torrential rain to snow blizzards and sudden temperature changes, the teams have their work cut out for them. Risking life and limb in some of Europe's harshest conditions, it takes a special breed of men and women to overcome the many challenges thay face on a daily basis. As the roads turn into icy bobsleigh tracks, haulage container vehicles and private cars and vans all get themselves into difficulties and need to be rescued by our road warrior heroes.

programme.title: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
programme.desc: In northern Chile, 33 miners were buried more than half a mile deep in the desert with no way to escape. Across a terrifying first 17 days, the men must overcome impossible conditions to stay alive. As each passing day makes survival seem less likely, desperation sets in until an extraordinary discovery changes everything.

programme.title: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
programme.desc: Rescuers establish contact with the miners, sparking hope. Supplies make it underground, alleviating the terror of being trapped without food or water. As the world watches, the rescue team races to find a way through solid rock, but every possible solution brings new risks. Then, the ingenuity and determination of this unprecedented rescue effort are threatened by a devastating mechanical failure.

programme.title: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
programme.desc: The miners enter their second month underground, and the focus on the surface shifts to the seemingly impossible task of bringing all 33 men safely home. The rescue enters a critical phase as the miners prepare to enter a tiny capsule designed to transport them, one by one, through a treacherous borehole to the surface.

programme.title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
programme.desc: Will heads to the South Pole, where temperatures can drop below minus 100 degrees Fahrenheit. He skis and treks across giant icefields, and, faced with a giant cliff of ice in bone-chilling winds, struggles to climb to the top. Only with the support of one of the world's best polar athletes, Richard Parks, does he succeed. In one of the planet's most isolated research stations, scientists take ice cores deep under the surface and make incredible sacrifices to pursue their research.

programme.title: Witness to Disaster
programme.desc: Montecito is hit by a devastating natural disaster that leaves its residents fighting for their lives. Overnight, the quiet Californian beach town is swamped by a terrifying series of thirty-feet high, boulder-filled debris flows that destroy homes and leave streets swimming in mud. Through eyewitness testimony and footage taken during the disaster, we reveal how split-seconds decisions made the difference between life and death.

programme.title: Witness to Disaster
programme.desc: The story of the largest wildfire in Portugal's history and how it devastated a rural community. As fire fighters tried to bring it under control, fierce winds from a thunderstorm combined with the fire. It quickly became unstoppable. Fleeing locals were caught in the inferno. 205 were injured, 66 were killed. Through forensic analysis, we reveal how this event unfolded and how split-second decisions made the difference between life and death.

programme.title: Witness to Disaster
programme.desc: The tornado super outbreak in April 2011 is unprecedented; over just 4 days, 360 tornadoes leave a trail of devastation as deadly weather systems build along the southern states of the USA. One of the deadliest tornadoes touches down in Alabama, and destroys two towns in 15 minutes. By 28th April, 348 people have been killed, thousands are homeless and the overall damage is in excess of 12 billion dollars.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay travels to Morocco, North Africa, where he embarks on an adventure deep in the Middle Atlas Mountains to understand ancient Berber cuisine. Learning from the locals, he rappels over a waterfall to meet mushroom hunters, milks a camel and experiences the life of the Berber people. He puts his new skills to the test, cooking a feast with chef Najat Kaanache to celebrate Berber New Year.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The volatile climate of Southeast Alaska challenges Port Protection's residents who live on the edge of society. Gary battles father time while securing needed resources. Curly pushes through in the wake of a tragic loss. Mary faces her fears to survive in extreme conditions. Sam fights to preserve the only lifestyle he's ever known. Squibb looks to improve upon his surroundings. And Stuart deals with past injuries as he battles the elements.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The volatile climate of Southeast Alaska challenges Port Protection's residents who live on the edge of society. Gary battles father time while securing needed resources. Curly pushes through in the wake of a tragic loss. Mary faces her fears to survive in extreme conditions. Sam fights to preserve the only lifestyle he's ever known. Squibb looks to improve upon his surroundings. And Stuart deals with past injuries as he battles the elements.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Car SOS is back for a sixth series with parts blagging petrolhead Tim Shaw and master mechanic Fuzz Townshend breathing life into classic cars for unsuspecting owners. This series yet another array of iconic cars including a 1990s Lancia Delta Integrale, a 60s Citroen DS, an 80s Peugeot 205 Rally car and a 1950s MGA. Special guests this series include actor James Nesbitt and Monte Carlo legend Paddy Hopkirk.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Car SOS is back for a sixth series with parts blagging petrolhead Tim Shaw and master mechanic Fuzz Townshend breathing life into classic cars for unsuspecting owners. This series yet another array of iconic cars including a 1990s Lancia Delta Integrale, a 60s Citroen DS, an 80s Peugeot 205 Rally car and a 1950s MGA. Special guests this series include actor James Nesbitt and Monte Carlo legend Paddy Hopkirk.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim & Fuzz head to Cambridge to rescue a big cuddly and cherished Range Rover. The Range Rover represented a huge change of gear for Land rover in 1970 when it was introduced. A big, comfortable car that was as smooth as a big saloon but could easily keep up with a Land Rover across a muddy field. The later 1991 Range Rover Vogue that Tim & Fuzz collect symbolized freedom and happy days for Margaret, her husband and their family. Used to tow their caravan all over the UK, this 4 wheel drive was always dependable that durable. Now a sad reminder of better times, the car is in desperate need of some TLC; Enter CarSOS. Fuzz stresses when he realizes the whole car is tired, rusty and likely to be a world of parts finding pain. For Tim it's a challenge he cant resist, coming up with the blag of his life to make this big project possible. The biggest challenge of all though is making the car accessible for Margaret who, with her disability getting worse, has started to really struggle to climb on board the tall car. Fuzz and Tim decide the way forward is to fit a whole new adjustable air suspension system. Finding a way to fit that in among the crowded body shell as well as overhauling tired major components such as both front and rear axles, keeps Fuzz flat out for days. Tim meanwhile sets out to find out how to make the best veneer in the country. All this, plus replacement parts in every other nook and cranny of this complex car, plus the usual spectacular paint job, result in a massive transformation. But will Margaret think a showroom rebirth is the right thing to do to her beloved car, and what has Fuzz been up to?

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: Amsterdam attracts 24 million tourists every year. The capital is one of Europe's leading tourist destinations. Visitors come to Amsterdam not only for the Rijksmuseum or its 165 picturesque canals, but many also for its 165 coffeeshops. Safety & Service officers Menno and Baran assist an American tourist who has fallen ill after using soft drugs. At the Ticket & Service department, Alexandra makes a game of guessing which country travelers come from. In the Lost & Found department, staff member Gusta searches for a missing backpack belonging to an American tourist. Tourists from the United Kingdom arrive at Amsterdam Central Station by high-speed train. At the dedicated UK Terminal, the team races against the clock to ensure the train to London departs on time.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: Festival season has kicked off in the city, culminating in the Amsterdam Dance Event, the world's largest electronic music festival. Around 500,000 dance enthusiasts from around the world are gathering in Amsterdam to attend the festivities. This means tens of thousands of extra passengers at the station. Safety & Service staff Menno and Baran are busy dealing with visitors who are using drugs excessively. Veteran Menno tries to keep his new colleague Baran in check when he chases a troublemaker who is under the influence. Amsterdam Central is also joining in the festivities, with various stages and a special Dance Train featuring a DJ. On board, conductor Errol is transported back to his time as a party animal.

programme.title: Top Guns: The Next Generation
programme.desc: One student's dreams of becoming a fighter pilot are put in jeopardy as the class starts advanced phase training with a set of breathtaking bombing tests. Diving at speeds they've never faced before, students struggle with the dynamic moves and start to make high-risk mistakes. Instructors deliver tough assessments in the debriefs to keep the students safe.

programme.title: Top Guns: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Landing on an aircraft carrier demands precision flying and is a skill vital for all U.S. Navy fighter pilots. As the students tackle the longest and most technical section of the advanced phase, they know it's a test they must pass to keep their dreams alive. The pressure mounts on some struggling students, and the commanding officer issues a timely warning to one.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Antinarcotics police officers at El Dorado International Airport must complete their mission to disrupt the activity of drug traffickers. First, they will detect an ingeniously hidden cocaine shipment with the help of specially trained dogs. Later, thanks to their X-ray equipment, they thwart the attempt of a man to smuggle cocaine capsules inside his stomach while they also rush to save his life. Immigrations officers live moments of dramatic tension when a mother tries to take her daughter out of the country with forged documents. Later, they must stop a passenger from evading justice by leaving the country. Meanwhile, the officers working at the post office will intercept a shipment of cocaine hidden inside an apparently innocent children's movie, and they will discover that a cargo of thirty handcrafted ceramic statuettes of Latin American political leaders might not be what it appears to be. In one of the security check-points, the infrared control system for luggage manages to catch an unexpected stash of ten kilograms of liquid cocaine, stored inside deodorant canisters. Later, the officers must sharpen their senses when the shoes of two passengers, pretending to be buddies on a holiday trip, might yield evidence that could land the two men in jail.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Officers from Colombian customs, immigration, and law enforcement agencies at El Dorado International Airport make sure national security is the top priority by cracking down on criminals attempting to smuggle illegal goods out of the country while also helping passengers in trouble. In this episode, a man is arrested after security agents find five kilograms of cocaine hidden in his suitcase. Astonished by the discovery, the passenger claims to be innocent and accuses his son in law of having tricked him. Two individuals posing as a couple of young tourists, turn out to be complete strangers carrying cocaine capsules inside their bodies. And then, officers unveil one of the boldest drugs smuggling attempt: a woman holding a cocaine "package" in her genital area. Meanwhile, immigration officers must prevent three passengers from flying to Sweden with forged passports, while trying to figure out their true identity and nationality. Later, drama and tension unfold as they carry an operation involving a charter flight with over 60 Colombians deported from the United States for different crimes.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: The Tale of Sylian
programme.desc: Nikola, a farmer grappling with the harsh reality of new economic policies, is unable to sell his land or crops. When his family leaves in search of a better life abroad, he takes a job as a landfill attendant, where he encounters the injured white stork Silyan. As Nikola nurses the bird back to health, an unlikely bond forms between man and animal.

programme.title: Endurance
programme.desc: In a legendary feat of leadership and perseverance, Antarctic explorer Ernest Shackleton kept his crew alive for over a year despite losing their ship in frigid pack ice. A century later, a team of explorers sets out to find the sunken ship. These landmark expeditions, bound by shared grit and determination, bookend one of history's greatest sagas of survival and the power of the human spirit.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece
programme.desc: Teams of archaeologists uncover evidence that sheds light on one of the most terrifying stories in history: the legend of King Minos and the fearsome Minotaur. Can new discoveries reveal what inspired these terrifying legends? Who were the mysterious Minoans, the society that gave rise to this myth?

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece
programme.desc: The Parthenon is one of the most iconic buildings in history. Today, a team of architects and engineers works to ensure its long-term survival. How was the Parthenon built, and what does it tell us about the rise of Athens in ancient Greece? As archaeologists across the Mediterranean unearth fragments of the past, they piece together the secrets of this remarkable civilization.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: Harriet Tubman saw her visions as divine messages from God, giving her the strength not only to liberate herself from the bondage of slavery but also to lead hundreds of other enslaved people to freedom by way of the Underground Railroad. In 2001, a blood-red rain falls over Kerala, inciting fears, superstitions and predictions of an imminent apocalypse. But Kerala is not the first city to experience this macabre downpour. And in ancient Greece, the oracle of Apollo at Didyma prophesied that Alexander the Great would invade and conquer the hulking Persian Empire, changing the course of history fore

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: After claiming to have received an ordained mission from Jesus Christ, Sun Myung Moon challenged traditional religious orthodoxy and established the Unification Church, a global movement that captivated millions. But, as the Church grew, so too did the accusations. Who was this godsend, and what were his motives? After Irene Hughes accurately predicts the assassination of JFK, the devastating 1967 Chicago blizzard and the murder of a wealthy heiress, she is given the distinction of America's Most Accurate Psychic. After disregarding the prophetic pronouncements of Rome's sacred chickens, Gen. Publius Claudius Pulcher meets his doom. It is a stark reminder of the consequences of defying the will of the gods.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: Air and Marine Operations agents in Fajardo chase a vessel to a marina and suspects flee, leaving over 280 kilos of cocaine hidden inside. Mayaguez AMO agents provide armed transport for the USCG, transferring a murder suspect from sea to airfield. Later, they intercept a migrant vessel by shooting out its engine. Agents in the U.S. Virgin Island seize over $750k in cash from a smuggling vessel.

programme.title: Drugs Inc.
programme.desc: When heroin users in America began turning up with raw lesions, decaying skin and grotesque sores on arms and legs, doctors were worried. The symptoms looked like those associated with Krokodil - a home-cooked, super-strong opiate that got its start in Siberian Russia. Made from codeine "cooked" with toxic ingredients, Krokodil can be stronger than heroin, and more addictive. But the DEA has yet to confirm the presence of Krokodil on US soil and suspected cases in Chicago and Niagara, NY, remain unproven. Heroin is cheap and widely available, so will US dealers and users go to the trouble and expense of sourcing codeine? Drugs Inc journeys to Georgia, Armenia and the Ukraine to meet Krokodil's users and dealers as they reveal the true horror of this home-made drug and, in the process, deliver a strong warning to America.

programme.title: Drugs Inc.
programme.desc: A dealer makes a drop at a Hollywood red carpet event; a family hustles back packs of paste through the Peruvian forest; a US Customs plane tracks a light aircraft as it makes a belly landing in the dead of night in Guatemalan; a Border Patrol Agent sweats his way through a tiny tunnel under the US-Mexican border, tracing its route as oxygen levels drop dangerously low; a wholesaler prepares a five-kilo shipment. At every step the price goes up, and the risks grow greater. Drugs Inc reveals the international supply chain of a drug that starts life as a leaf and ends up as a powder more valuable than gold: cocaine.

programme.title: Drugs Inc.
programme.desc: Thailand is in the grip of an addiction epidemic that is spinning out of control, as a candy-colored meth pill called yaba overtakes every other drug used in the country. Yaba in Thai means 'crazy medicine,' and heavy use of the pill can trigger psychosis. The death penalty hangs over every dealer, but that does not seem to deter them. Dealers find many ways to dodge the cops and customs authorities to keep the profits rolling in.

programme.title: Last of the Giants
programme.desc: Growing to over 12 feet long and 1300 pounds, the prehistoric white sturgeon is a true freshwater giant, but because of human activity, its populations are now in decline. Cyril and his crew embark on a dangerous, action-packed mission to help scientists protect them. But to find this massive animal, the team must search the raging mountain rivers and dive beneath their frigid waters, all while avoiding bears, rock slides, freezing temperatures and deadly currents.

programme.title: Last of the Giants
programme.desc: An exhausting battle with a colossal white sturgeon pushes Cyril to the limit, but before the team can tag the eight-foot giant, it gives them a giant-sized shock. A freak wind storm then forces the team to put their white sturgeon quest on hold and head far north into the mountains to help protect the sturgeon's main food source: the pacific salmon. In order to find these migrating warrior fish, that can weigh up to 100 pounds, the guys will have to leave civilization behind and survive in one of the most hostile, rugged mountain environments in the world. Out here, hostile terrain, black bears and grizzly bears lurk around every corner.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club 4.
programme.desc: Documentary series featuring fearsome fights between the biggest and the baddest animals on planet. Watch the animals fighting for their food, territory, rights and life. Follow the drama and adrenaline of the toughest and fearcest fights in savannah, jungles and water. It is an ultimate survival with no rules whatsoever. Uncover the extraordinary motivations and strategies used by the animal world.

programme.title: Extraordinary Australia
programme.desc: Australias coastline is a true natural wonder, encompassing a diverse range of bountiful habitats. Coastal seas and lands are realms of epic migrations, mesmerising mating rituals and high stakes battles between predator and prey.

programme.title: Ocean's Weirdest
programme.desc: In and near the sea, hunting luck sometimes makes the difference between life and death. No matter whether it is sharks, shrimp, small fish, or other creatures, all of them can turn out to be real tricksters.

programme.title: Ocean's Weirdest
programme.desc: Life in and the ocean sometimes leads to some strange developments. An octopus, that has developed a special fondness for coconuts, and a loves struck albatross, are just two of these unusual deviations.

programme.title: Madagascar's Weirdest
programme.desc: Madagascar is an island nation set adrift for millions of years, leaving its wildlife in extreme isolation and causing some bizarre adaptations. Many of the creatures here are found nowhere else on earth. From the feared fossa to the mysterious aye-aye, a

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Against all odds, Kio survives a buffalo attack, but his troubles are far from over. At 12 weeks old, he is the youngest and most vulnerable member of the pride. To have any hope of one day becoming king, he must earn the respect of his older brothers and find his place among them. Just as he is finally able to gain their acceptance, the dry season sets in, and food becomes scarce. This leaves Summer to make an extraordinary decision to protect Kio's future.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: In spring, the Carpathian Mountains' rarest forms of life burst free from the harshness of winter, beginning with an extraordinary moment when a mother bear emerges from hibernation. Her three tiny, yet adorable, cubs experience the world for the first time, following her across sheer cliffs in search of food. Meanwhile, in Slovakia's Tatra Mountains, a rare male capercaillie bird performs an elaborate mating ritual. In Ukraine, Ural owls are on the hunt to feed their chicks, while newly born chamois kids leap down precipitous snowfields, cheating death as they evade the soaring eagles above. The key to it all — the ancient trees themselves — provides not only a sanctuary but also the very beginnings of life itself, through their superpower of "eating the sun" and passing energy up the food chain in this vast, interconnected web of life.

programme.title: Lion

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The Alps are changing, not in dramatic leaps but in slow, steady shifts. Rising temperatures and decades of human activity are transforming this once-stable mountain region. Ibex, marmots and ptarmigans each face their own challenges in the alpine world, but with change comes new opportunities. How will the different species adapt? In the valleys, the altered flow of rivers threatens bird species that nest on open gravel. Experience a fragile world in motion.

programme.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
programme.desc: Through the cycle of the seasons, Spain's Sierra de Gredos National Park, one of Europe's most remarkable natural landscapes, is revealed. From ancient glacial cirques and deep mountain ravines to the summit of Almanzor, the highest peak in central Spain, discover a unique and fragile ecosystem. Here, the Spanish ibex, an iconic species that defines the spirit of these mountains, reigns. Alongside it, golden eagles, alpine birds and otters inhabit a territory shaped by isolation and resilience. This is a portrait of wilderness and balance, a window into one of Europe's last great wild spaces.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Lions kill four buffaloes in a stampede, while in another drying river a buffalo fights off five of the big cats. As the dry winter looms, heading out on a game drive means checking in at all the remaining waterholes. This is where the action plays out. Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Hungry crocs battle a dangerous pod of hippos. The hippos take on a group of male lions. A honey badger battles for life against leopards, and wild dogs cause chaos everywhere they go! In the wilds of Southern Africa, the long, dry winter brings a desperation to the animals who live here. Prepare yourself for a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Mūsu varoņi ir atpakaļ, un šoreiz Briežu komanda pametīs šīs pasaules robežas! Gatavojies varonīgai planētas glābšanai ar dažādiem uzlabojumiem, jauniem tēliem, foršām lietām un satriecošiem piedzīvojumiem kosmosā!

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims izzina Rūkoņtaunu, lai atrastu vietu, kur baudīt jautrību vienatnē. Tims un Kaja cenšas sarīkot Pārkijam neaizmirstamu dienu. Kad vētras dēļ Reksiem jāpaliek mājās, viņiem jāizdomā, kā pavadīt laiku.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Arvien jauni piedzīvojumi ar Doru! Piebiedrojies drošajai pētniecei Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu brīnumainajos piedzīvojumos - no došanās palīgā dzīvniekiem kopā ar Djego līdz apburtas nāru pasaules glābšanai.

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Deizijas vecmāmiņa Zenija ierodas ciemos, un Krokodila kungs, kuram pašam nav vecmāmiņas, ir sajūsmā viņu satikt. Uzzinot, ka Deizija, Deizijas mamma, un vecmāmiņa Zenija ir radinieki, Krokodila kungs neredz, kur viņš iederas. Viņš domā, ka viņam jāpieliek papildu pūles un jāatstāj iespaids uz vecmāmiņu Zeniju, lai iekarotu viņas mīlestību. Taču katrs mēģinājums beidzas ar neveiksmi, un viņš baidās, ka nekad neiekaros viņas sirdi.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Vecākus pārsteidz aizvien vairāku reklāmas izkārtņu parādīšanās gar viņu ceļu. Gaisma no reklāmām ir tik spoža, ka naktī vairs nevar saskatīt zvaigznes un visur ir tik daudz stabu! Pietiks! Ģimenei jārīkojas! // Barbalala vēlas kļūt par kovbojmeiteni un Barbazū ir apņēmies viņai palīdzēt. Lai to panāktu, viņai jāiemācās aprūpēt govis un bulli. Tas nav viegli, bet, ja viņa pacentīsies, viņa būs lieliska kovbojmeitene.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais pastāsta pārējiem, cik vareni bija Da Vinči izgudrojumi un nu katrs grib izgudrot ko savu. Ģēniju ir maz, bet ir jautri izgudrot. // Bērniem jāizvēlas - doties baseinā vai izbraukt ar riteņiem. Uzreiz izveidojas divas frontes un tikai Barbazū spēj nosvērt izvēles svarus.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims cenšas atgriezt pazudušu rāciju tās īpašniekam. Tims un Tomijs dodas kempingā, bet nespēj vienoties, ar ko sākt. Kad Tims atrod bērnības rotaļlietu Blobertu, tas atmodina viņā monstru.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tomijs piedalās raķešu sacīkstēs, Tims atbalsta savu brāli. Tims novērš Tijas domas no Taskija, kamēr tas mazgājas veļas mašīnā. Bērni kļūst par vecākiem, un vecāki - par bērniem.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims izmēģina jaunus raķešzābakus, kas drīz kļūst nekontrolējami. Tims, Tomijs un Tija pieskata mēness papagaili. Tims, Tomijs un Tija sacenšas ar vecākiem astesbumbā.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Pēc sniegota pārsteiguma pienākšanas, Rabla komanda piedāvā palīdzēt Hedlija viesnīcā. Kad kāpnes izrādās nepietiekami ātras, ir laiks celt. Karls adoptē kaķēnus. Kad viņi izraisa popkorna elli, Rabla komanda padara kafejnīcu kaķēniem draudzīgu.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Reindžere Roza lūdz Rabla komandu salabot Lāču salas tiltu. Kad remontdarbos iejaucas Ātrmeistars, ķepaiņiem jāsatīra viņa radītā nekārtība un jāpasargā lāčus no ātri tuvojošās vētras... ar tantes Celtnes jaunās Būvētavas Bultas palīdzību.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Sers Tērauds rada traci parādes laikā, lai lēdija varētu iepirkties mierā. Vai Briežu komanda izglābs parādi? Bobija ziedputekšņi izraisa visiem superšķavas. Lola aktivizē aprūpes centru, lai visiem palīdzētu!

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dorai, Zābaciņam un Benijam jādodas cauri lietusmežam, lai nogādātu Benija vecmammai lielu, skaistu piena kūku. Dora palīdz Fiestas trio noskaidrot, kas rada skaļo, savādo troksni, kura dēļ viņi pazaudējuši savus instrumentus.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tomijs piedalās raķešu sacīkstēs, Tims atbalsta savu brāli. Tims novērš Tijas domas no Taskija, kamēr tas mazgājas veļas mašīnā. Bērni kļūst par vecākiem, un vecāki - par bērniem.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Kad vētras dēļ Reksiem jāpaliek mājās, viņiem jāizdomā, kā pavadīt laiku.

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabērni pielipuši pie televizora, tāpēc vecāki mudina viņus veidot raidījumus. Barbapapas apmeklē evolūcijas muzeju. Programmā: Zemes radīšana, Pirmskembrija perioda zemūdene un... dinozauri!

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbazū gatavs palīdzēt, bet Barbagudrais un Barbabella ļaunprātīgi izmanto viņa labestību un padara viņu traku. Barbazū nejauši atklāj spēju atdarināt Barbatēti. Viņš to izmanto, lai sadalītu darbus brāļiem un māsām. Vai viņi to uzzinās?

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Pēc piedzīvotām likstām Barbabravo vairs nemaz nespēj pārtapt. Visa ģimene dodas viņam palīgā. Barbabravo nespēj nosēdēt mierā un ilgi koncentrēties vienai nodarbei. Barbalala piedāvā iemācīt viņam kontroli. Vai viņai izdosies?

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Krokodilkungs baidās, ka tiks spiests izvēlēties starp senu labāko draugu Bazziju un jaunu labāko draudzeni Deiziju. Deizijas un Krokodilkunga vienkāršā mājiņa kokā tiek sarežģīta, kad viņi cenšas to paplašināt draugu dēļ.

programme.title: Ķepaiņu lietas
programme.desc: Antropomorfisku dzīvnieku pasaulē Sems Snovs un Kita Keisija ir elitāri KLEID (Slepenā dzīvnieku detektīvu ekspertu līga) aģenti, kas apceļo pasauli un risina noslēpumus, liekot lietā problēmu risināšanas un dzīvnieku faktu pārzināšanas prasmes.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda būvē autosstāvietu saldējuma kafejnīcas klientiem. Rouza rīko kempingu, bet Rabls baidās no tumsas. Draugi uzbūvē zvaigznes.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda uzbūvē māju vecā kokā - īstu štābiņu vairākos stāvos! Izbēg fermeres Zojas jaunās vistiņas, Rabla komandai darba pilnas rokas.

Taču, kad viņa un Kārtera kungs nejauši paši tiek pietīti pie karuseļa, Ķepu patruļai jāpalīdz viņus atbrīvot! // Šodien ir ikgadējais Piedzīvojumu līča dziedāšanas konkurss, kurā noskaidros pilsētas labāko dziedātāju! programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims nolemj pierādīt, ka Kajas tētis ir kapteinis Dinostārs. Tims cenšas atpūsties, bet Tijai ir citi plāni. Tims nopērk labākos cepumus pilsētā, bet drīz saprot, ka citiem tos vajag vairāk nekā viņam.

programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Arvien jauni piedzīvojumi ar Doru! Piebiedrojies drošajai pētniecei Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu brīnumainajos piedzīvojumos - no došanās palīgā dzīvniekiem kopā ar Djego līdz apburtas nāru pasaules glābšanai.

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Ray Fillet is attacked in Central Park by a mutant turtle! Donnie's busy with his robotics project: turning Metalhead into a spider-bot. Wingnut bursts in and tells the Turtles to come quick- Ray is hurt! A woozy Ray blames the Ninja Turtles, and the Mutanimals start a fight with the confused brothers. But when Ray's REAL attacker appears, a mutant snapping turtle named TOKKA, he fights everyone... until his watch starts beeping and he escapes. The Turtles tail him, ending up on the Staten Island ferry. After a big fight, Tokka's trapped. But while questioning him, Tokka explodes into OOZE, leaving only a baby turtle and his watch. Donnie's brothers ask him to hack it and find clues about Tokka, which he says is impossible! Later, Donnie gets a location pin from Wingnut and follows it to an abandoned factory on Staten Island. He finds her and ANOTHER TOKKA that he cleverly takes out! Donnie thinks they're safe until MORE Monster Mutanimals emerge! Could Donnie's day get any worse?"

programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.desc: Nine-year-old twins, Jade and Mica know Marsupilimis are real, as their explorer parents entrusted them with three precious eggs that hatched into Marsups named Hope, Twister, and Punch. They now live happily with the twins and their Gran Gran Suzanne above the family restaurant The Chahuta in Palombia, whilst the Twins parents search for the Marsups family. Living with three young Marsupilamis is an endless source of adventures. Jade and Mica love having having fun with them, but know, it's essential to keep their existence hidden from the outside world to keep them safe. Every day brings new challenges - taking the Marsupilamis to the park can quickly turn into a frantic race through the sewers and a confrontation with a wild jaguar, or a game of golf can result in capture by Stan the zoologist! Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.desc: Knuckles the Dread's pirate crew rages against Dr. Deep and Dr. Done It. The Eggforcers triumph and take Dredd's shard, abandoning the captive Rusty Rose behind, gutting any allegiance she felt. The doctors' escape, is halted by mystery energy.

programme.desc: Phoebe and Max unwittingly let Chloe's friends watch a horror movie and eat candy, leaving them traumatized and craving more sugar. Jinx and Booch's parents want to meet with Chloe's parents to discuss the lack of supervision at the beach house. With Hank and Barb away, Max and Phoebe are determined to prove they can be good guardians, and use a disguise gadget to transform into their parents to help Chloe. It goes well until the real Hank and Barb show up, and must transform into Max and Phoebe to keep the ruse going.

programme.title: Danger Force
programme.desc: This fun spin-off of Henry Danger is set in the Swellview Academy for the Gifted and follows the adventures of four young friends. Chapa, Miles, Bose and Mika were ordinary kids, until they discovered they have superpowers. They are recruited by Captain Man to become his new crime-fighting crew, and protect the city of Swellview from various villains. But before that Captain Man must teach them how to control their superpowers, as well as to how to work as a team, using Schwoz as his helper.

programme.title: Henry Danger

While producing a webshow Carly is not looking for fame or fortune. Ideally she wants to be a role model for children and teenagers. iCarly ultimately features everything from comedy sketches and talent contests to interviews, recipes, and problem-solving.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Plans for the landmark 50th web cast of iCarly are at risk of being curtailed when Sam gets detention. Realizing she can't do the show without her co-host, Carly and Freddie try to get in trouble themselves, so they can do the live web cast from their school's detention room. However, deliberately trying to get detention proves to be far more difficult than Carly can imagine, and even harder for Freddie.

programme.title: Victorious
programme.desc: Victorious tells the story of the sixteen year old Tori Vega. She grows up in the shadow of her older sister Trina, the big star of the family. But this suddenly changes as Tori attends Hollywood Arts, the best high school of performing arts. Soon she finds out that it is difficult to find her way and be accepted by her fellow students. While Tori is a great singer, dancer and actress, she doesn't realise it. Gradually she finds out that she is a true entertainer and very talented.

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Prepare to meet the strangest match made in bestie heaven -- Sam & Cat! Sam's loud, independent, and tough as nails, while Cat is sweet as pie and super flighty. But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies! Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Donnie's trapped in a mad scientist's lab by the Monster Mutanimals Tokka, Rahzar, Scale Tail, Antrax and Wyrm who are after Wingnut's blood. Meanwhile, Leo, Mikey and Raph try to get pizza but the shop owner is furious: they've made a mess of the place too many times! But the Turtles have never been there before! They're confused until another Tokka wrecks the place in a huge fight before exploding into ooze...and then another Tokka arrives! In the lab, Donnie plans his escape but stumbles upon a video of Rahzar who explains the Monster Mutanimals are doomed unless they find the blood of a stable mutant... and they need Donatello's help! A real-life Rahzar lunges at Donnie, who fights him off until a whole pack of Monster Mutants shows up. The other three Turtles track their Tokka to the lab but are quickly captured. Donnie can only watch as his brothers are shoved into cages... and confronted by the creator of the Monster Mutanimals, the mad scientist Jordan Perry!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: iCarly

Because Sam's scheme involves Freddie, Carly decided to tell only him about it, and Carly can't decide whether the guilt over Sam's amateur hacking or Freddie's sophisticated effort to undo the fix will gnaw away at her conscience first.

programme.title: Sam & Cat

But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies! Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

This pushes him to a life of crime-fighting vigilantism, starting with putting the Purple Dragons in their place. But when he's caught on camera and his brothers and April see this Turtle-shaped hero on the news, they interrogate him: what's he up to... and can they get in on it? Now, the four Night Ninjas and April suit up and set out to rid the streets of crime in a single night. Now what's left to do? April finds a dog-napping ring that's been snatching up purebreds. Baiting the dog-nappers with a fancy pooch, the Turtles track the criminals and meet the villainous French florist known as... La Fleur! She and her band of hench-florists are using the dog-napping as a cover-up for a much larger crime. And when the Night Ninjas show up to stop her, it may be too late for Leo and his brothers as the whole thing goes up in flames... literally.

Despite all this, Lily and Jack attempt to accomplish the impossible.

programme.title: Spried ar Delfi
programme.desc: Katru darba dienu kopā ar dažādu nozaru speciālistiem, kā arī "Delfi" un citu mediju žurnālistiem aicinām skatītājus spriest par kādu aktuālu tematu - politiķu lēmumiem un to sekām, amatpersonu rīcību un tās motīviem, pārmaiņām sabiedrībā un tās virzītām iniciatīvām, pasaulē notiekošo un tā ietekmi uz Latviju, sasniegumiem un zaudējumiem sportā, kultūras personībām un procesiem.

programme.title: Nolaid slieksni!
programme.desc: Raidījumu cikla "Nolaid slieksni" trešajā epizodē - Mārtiņš Vizulis. Viņš ir biedrības "Teodors" priekšsēdētājs, masieris un aktīva dzīvesveida piekritējs, kurš aizraujas ar cīņas sportu un citām aktivitātēm. Mārtiņam ir redzes invaliditāte, tāpēc Ikdienas gaitās klātesošs ir suns pavadonis Romeo, kas palīdz orientēties un pārvietoties. Mārtiņa stāsts atklāj, ka cilvēka iespējas strādāt un pilnvērtīgi iesaistīties sabiedrības dzīvē nereti ierobežo nevis redzes traucējumi,bet gan apkārtējās vides nepieejamība un sabiedrībā pastāvošie stereotipi. Cik viegli cilvēkam ar redzes invaliditāti ir atrast darbu, profesionāli realizēties un pierādīt savas spējas darba vidē? "Nolaid slieksni" aicina pamanīt ne tikai fiziskos, bet arī cilvēku aizspriedumu radītos sliekšņus. "Raidījumu cikls tapis Labklājības ministrijas kampaņā "Nolaid slieksni" ar Eiropas Sociālā fonda Plus atbalstu."

programme.title: Kā pieci pirksti
programme.desc: Kopējā Latvijas iekšējo virszemes ūdeņu platība aizņem aptuveni 3,7 % no valsts teritorijas, kas ir nedaudz vairāk par 2300 km². Šo platību veido tūkstošiem upju, ezeru un mākslīgo ūdenstilpju . Svarīgs uzdevums ir šo ūdeņu efektīva un dabai draudzīga apsaimniekošana .Šajā raidījumā apskatīsim dažādas metodes kā notiek rūpes par ūdeņiem un tiem līdzās esošajām teritorijām.

programme.title: Aizkulisēs
programme.desc: Par režisores Ināras Sluckas iestudēto drāmu "Sievietes daļas" Nacionālajā teātrī. Tas ir ungāru dramaturģes Katas Vēberes smeldzīgs stāsts par ģimenes un, galvenokārt, sievietes pārdzīvojumu, zaudējot bērnu.

programme.title: Tīklā TTT Leģendas dzimšana
programme.desc: Otrajā "TTT Tīklā" epizodē raidījuma vadītāja Māra Sleja satiekas ar aktieri Artūru Skrastiņu, lai runātu par lomu, kuru viņš atveido filmā "Tīklā. TTT leģendas dzimšana". Saruna atklāj, cik cieši aktiera personība saistās ar ekrānā redzamo tēlu - Paulu Strazdu, un kā šī vēsturiskā figūra iegūst mūsdienīgu emocionālo elpu. Artūrs godīgi stāsta par savu darba metodi - par to, ka tēls rodas nevis no dokumentālām detaļām, bet no iekšējās loģikas, stāsta diktētās rīcības un intuitīvas reakcijas kameru priekšā. Viņš dalās pieredzē par lēmumu pieņemt lomu un atklāt ko jaunu, lai arī gadiem ilgi uzkrātā pieredze bieži šķiet jau izspēlēta. Saruna ievelk arī filmēšanas aizkulisēs: nakts aina, kurā, kadra autentiskuma vārdā, tiek izsmēķētas vairākas cigarešu paciņas, lai visdziļākajā veidā var attēlot varoņa emocionālo stavokli; par filmēšanu īstajā "Čekas mājā", kur vēstures klātbūtne ir teju fiziski jūtama. Tāpat Artūrs stāsta par enerģiju, kas rodas komandā, par uzticēšanos partnerim un par to, kā pat apavi vai labi pašūts kostīms var kļūt par tikpat svarīgu lomas daļu kā teksts. Šis ir sirnīgs un dzīvs stāsts par profesiju, kas prasa gan fizisku izturību, gan emocionālu atvērtību. Stāsts par filmu, kas atklāj maz zināmu, bet būtisku Latvijas vēstures posmu.

programme.title: Dzīvot un sadzīvot
programme.desc: Jauns, nebijis TV raidījums "Dzīvot un sadzīvot", kas cilvēkiem ļaus pieņemt un izprast savu slimību, iemācīties ar to sadzīvot, mazinot tās negatīvās izpausmes, lai spētu dzīvot kvalitatīvi, nekļūstot par slimības upuri un nastu tuviniekiem. Tas ir iespējams, uzturot regulāru kontaktu ar ārstu. Izmantojot jaunākās medicīnas inovācijas un pieeju, pacienti veiksmīgi var sadzīvot ar diagnozi, kaut sākotnēji šķiet - nākotne vairs nav iespējama! Sniegsim arī atbalsta plecu pacientu tuviniekiem, kas nereti sajūtas ķīlnieka lomā. Šis ir projekts par partnerību pacientam, viņa tuviniekiem un ārstam. Mūsdienās ārsts nav tikai speciālists, kas atklāj slimības un ārstē tās. Ārsts ir uzticams partneris ilgam un, galvenais, kvalitatīvam mūžam, jo pieaugot cilvēku dzīves ilgumam, tikai loģiski pieaug arī hronisko slimību apjoms, kuras mūsdienās ir iespējams lieliski pārvaldīt. Kā? To visu uzzināsiet 12 raidījumu ciklā ""Dzīvot un sadzīvot"", kas pie skatītājiem nonāks jau 6.oktobrī 22.00 kanālā ReTV. Raidījuma vadītaja, koučs Iveta Komisāre-Gorodņičija, kas sadarbībā ar Veselības centru apvienības vadošajiem ekspertiem ļaus skatītājiem būt līdzestīgiem diskusijai raidījumā "Dzīvot un sadzīvot".

programme.title: Copes Frekvence
programme.desc: Saruna ar vienu no spēcīgākajām Latvijas sporta makšķerēšanas ekipāžām - Romanu Ostapovu un Marku Petunovu, kuri aizvadītajā sezonā kļuva par Latvijas čempioniem spiningošanā no laivām. Runājam par ceļu līdz čempionu titulam, startu Latvijas izlases sastāvā, sporta makšķerēšanas aizkulisēm un to, ko sacensības iemāca par zivju uzvedību. Romans ikdienā strādā arī par copes gidu, tāpēc sarunā netrūkst praktisku padomu un plēsīgo zivju copes noslēpumu, kas noderēs ikvienam makšķerniekam.

programme.title: Ceļā uz mājām
programme.desc: Artūrs un Anna nesen iegādājušies ģimenes māju, taču tai nepieciešama fasādes krāsas atjaunošana, jo iepriekš izvēlējušies nepareizo toni. Lauris Zalāns ar Madaru Kivkucāni ne tikai pieliks roku, lai krāsošanas darbi uz priekšu iet raitāk, bet arī aprunāsies ar krāsu ekspertu, lai noskaidrotu ko ņemt vērā, lai izdodas atrast īsto toni ar pirmo reizi.

programme.title: Svētku kūka
programme.desc: Šonedēļ taps viena no vērtīgākajām kūkām - citronu kūka, jo citroni ir jāēd! Kūku versiju ir daudz, taču Ilze Kupča Kūciņa piedāvās savu kūkas redzējumu. Tā būs maiga, garda un veselīga. Bet arī šoreiz uz sarunu viesis nāks ciemos pie Ilzes. Būs sarunas par mūziku ar čella solisti, komponisti un virtuozu mākslinieci Ernu Daugavieti. Erna Daugaviete — viena no izcilākajām Latvijas čellistēm, plaši pazīstama ar emocionāli dziļajām un tehniski precīzajām interpretācijām. Komponiste, kura ar īpašu spēju spēj radīt vesela orķestra skanējumu. Erna spēlē bez notīm, aranžē mūziku šeit un tagad. Ilze un Erna ar kūku sarunās par dzīvi.

programme.title: Mājā un sētā
programme.desc: Raidījums "Mājā un sētā" aicina iepazīt dzīvi laukos un pilsētās caur radošām idejām, saimnieku pieredzi un praktiskiem padomiem ikdienai. Raidījumā stāstām par aktuālajiem dārza darbiem, sezonas norisēm laukos, jaunumiem un aktualitātēm saimniekiem, kā arī dalāmies iedvesmojošos risinājumos mājai, pagalmam un dārzam. Dodamies ciemos pie čakliem un radošiem cilvēkiem, kuri ar aizrautību veido skaistu un mājīgu vidi sev apkārt, atklājam noderīgus knifus saimniecībā un meklējam idejas, ko ikviens var izmantot savā ikdienā. Tāpat iepazīstam arī sabiedrībā zināmu personu mīļdzīvniekus un runājam par to, kā aizņemtajā ritmā atrast laiku rūpēm, atpūtai un iedvesmai jauniem darbiem.

programme.title: Latvijas stāsti
programme.desc: Stāsti par nozīmīgiem notikumiem, dažādām iniciatīvām, inovācijām, kas virza reģionu attīstību, gan kultūras kustībām, sabiedrisko līdzdalību. Stāsti, kas sākas reģionos, bet atsaucas kopējā Latvijas izaugsmē. Tie ir Latvijas stāsti par izaugsmi, par veiksmēm un nacionālu domāšanu.

programme.title: Spried ar Delfi
programme.desc: Katru darba dienu kopā ar dažādu nozaru speciālistiem, kā arī "Delfi" un citu mediju žurnālistiem aicinām skatītājus spriest par kādu aktuālu tematu - politiķu lēmumiem un to sekām, amatpersonu rīcību un tās motīviem, pārmaiņām sabiedrībā un tās virzītām iniciatīvām, pasaulē notiekošo un tā ietekmi uz Latviju, sasniegumiem un zaudējumiem sportā, kultūras personībām un procesiem.

programme.title: Mēs darām tā
programme.desc: Katrs no videostāstiem seko līdzi galveno varoņu dienas gaitām, īpašu vērību pievēršot viņu iestrādātajai zaļā dzīvesstila rutīnai, kas saistīta gan ar saimniekošanu mājās, darbā un dārzā, atkritumu šķirošanu, enerģijas avotu un transporta izvēli, ēšanas paradumiem, darba pienākumu organizēšanu un atpūtu. Tie ļauj ielūkoties, piemēram, šobrīd Rīgā lielākās apkaimes biedrības pārstāvju ikdienā, kuri Grīziņkalnā rūpējas par zaļas un labiekārtotas ārtelpas izveidi, kā arī Pierīgas novadu mājsaimniecībās, vērtējot dažādu apkures veidu efektivitāti un draudzīgumu videi, dažādu mākslinieku saimniekošanas paradumos u.c. Raidījumu vada aktrise un kostīmu māksliniece Madara Botmane, iepazīstinot ar planētai draudzīga dzīvesstila ikdienas paradumiem Latvijas kopienās, komūnās, kolektīvos, apkaimēs un vairāku paaudžu ģimeņu mājvietās.

programme.title: Peru piezīmes: Kusko
programme.desc: Uzņēmējs, ceļotājs un dēkainis Gundars Bojārs dodas nākamajā piedzīvojumā un šoreiz - pilnīgi viens. Šis Gundaram būs solo pārgājiens, ekspedīcija Andu Kalnu apvidū, Peru. Mērķis šim piedzīvojumam gan nav konkrēta vieta, bet gan pats ceļš un piedzīvojums, ko izdomātais maršruts sagādā. 10 dienas vienatnē, visa iedzīve sakrāmēta mugursomā, skarbi laikapstākļi. Kāds būs dēkaiņa Gundara Bojāra piedzīvojums tālajā Peru?

programme.title: Zini savas tiesības
programme.desc: Civillikums paredz, ka laulība netiek šķirta, ja laulātie nav vienojušies par saskarsmes kārtību ar kopīgo nepilngadīgo bērnu/ bērniem. Turklāt visās darbībās prioritāri ir jānodrošina bērna tiesības un intereses. Par to nedrīkst aizmirst arī vecāki, kas turpmāk nedzīvos kopā, vienojoties par saskarsmes tiesībām ar bērnu. Diemžēl dzīvē ne vienmēr šādās situācijās izdodas iztikt bez savstarpējām vecāku ķildām, bērna intereses atstājot otrajā plānā. Diskusijā zvērināts advokāts Aldis Liepiņš, Rīgas pilsētas tiesas tiesnesis Dainis Slišāns skaidros, kā vecākiem rīkoties, kā nodrošināt, lai bērna labklājība vienmēr paliktu galvenajā lomā.

programme.title: Līdaku ielenktie
programme.desc: ReTV ar prieku piedāvā skatītājiem pirmo Latvijā tapušo dokumentālo piedzīvojumu TV seriālu makšķerniekiem! Tas būs saistošs gan mūsu lielajai copmaņu komūnai, gan arī dabas piedzīvojumu cienītājiem. Seriālā atspoguļotas sešu pieredzējušu piedzīvojumu meklētāju-makšķernieku gaitas, pirmo reizi dodoties ar mašīnām un jumta teltīm Norvēģijas virzienā, meklējot tās mazskartajos ūdeņos līdakas, foreles un citas zivis. Pirms došanās ceļā pavadītas daudz stundas, rūpīgi pētot kartes, ūdeņus, makšķernieku forumus Latvijā un Novēģijā, kā arī ievācot informāciju no tiem retajiem Latvijas makšķerniekiem, kas pabijuši Norvēģijas iekšzemes ūdeņos, meklējot līdakas un citas zivis. Salikts plāns, kura viena no stabilākajām un nemainīgajām lietām ir… pārmaiņas, pielāgošanās apstākļiem, nezināmajam un neparedzamajam. 10 dienās džeki saskārās gan ar copi, gan necopi, gan izmisumu, gan plānu maiņu, gan viegliem, gan grūtiem lēmumiem un visu citu, kas piestāv šādam ceļojumam.

programme.title: Dzīvīte
programme.desc: Raidījumā tiks apskatītas dažādas tēmas un noskaidrotas atbildes uz neskaidriem sadzīves jautājumiem, piemēram, juridiskas dabas vai par sociāliem pakalpojumiem. Sadarbībā ar vadošo ārstniecības iestāžu speciālistiem tiks stāstīts arī par medicīnas aktualitātēm, veselību un veselīgu dzīvesveidu, kā arī citām svarīgām lietām.

programme.title: Nolaid slieksni!
programme.desc: Raidījumu cikla "Nolaid slieksni" trešajā epizodē - Mārtiņš Vizulis. Viņš ir biedrības "Teodors" priekšsēdētājs, masieris un aktīva dzīvesveida piekritējs, kurš aizraujas ar cīņas sportu un citām aktivitātēm. Mārtiņam ir redzes invaliditāte, tāpēc Ikdienas gaitās klātesošs ir suns pavadonis Romeo, kas palīdz orientēties un pārvietoties. Mārtiņa stāsts atklāj, ka cilvēka iespējas strādāt un pilnvērtīgi iesaistīties sabiedrības dzīvē nereti ierobežo nevis redzes traucējumi,bet gan apkārtējās vides nepieejamība un sabiedrībā pastāvošie stereotipi. Cik viegli cilvēkam ar redzes invaliditāti ir atrast darbu, profesionāli realizēties un pierādīt savas spējas darba vidē? "Nolaid slieksni" aicina pamanīt ne tikai fiziskos, bet arī cilvēku aizspriedumu radītos sliekšņus. "Raidījumu cikls tapis Labklājības ministrijas kampaņā "Nolaid slieksni" ar Eiropas Sociālā fonda Plus atbalstu."

programme.title: Ceļā uz mājām
programme.desc: Artūrs un Anna nesen iegādājušies ģimenes māju, taču tai nepieciešama fasādes krāsas atjaunošana, jo iepriekš izvēlējušies nepareizo toni. Lauris Zalāns ar Madaru Kivkucāni ne tikai pieliks roku, lai krāsošanas darbi uz priekšu iet raitāk, bet arī aprunāsies ar krāsu ekspertu, lai noskaidrotu ko ņemt vērā, lai izdodas atrast īsto toni ar pirmo reizi.

programme.title: Ventas balss
programme.desc: Raidījums "Ventas Balss" aicina skatītājus doties iedvesmojošā ceļojumā gar Ventas upes krastiem, iepazīstot cilvēkus, kuru dzīve, darbs un stāsti savijušies ar šo apkaimi. Šajā epizodē stāstīsim par Ventspils novadu. Nesen Piejūras brīvdabas muzejā vienā dienā varēja satikt Ventspils novada divpadsmit pagastus. Taču ar vienu dienu nepietiek, lai saprastu, kā novads dzīvo ikdienā, tādēļ mēs no muzeja dodamies ārā, lai dotos ceļā un apciemotu dažus no pagastiem un aprunātos ar to iedzīvotājiem.

programme.title: Reģionālās Televīzijas piedāvā
programme.desc: 17:00 Vidzemē (Vidzemes TV); 17:15 Jēkabpils laiks (Vidusdaugavas TV); 17:30 Ventspils ziņas (Ventas balss); 17:45 TV Kurzeme piedāvā.

programme.title: Es daru tā
programme.desc: Katrs no videostāstiem seko līdzi galveno varoņu dienas gaitām, īpašu vērību pievēršot viņu iestrādātajai zaļā dzīvesstila rutīnai, kas saistīta gan ar saimniekošanu mājās, darbā un dārzā, atkritumu šķirošanu, enerģijas avotu un transporta izvēli, ēšanas paradumiem, darba pienākumu organizēšanu un atpūtu. Tie ļauj ielūkoties, piemēram, šobrīd Rīgā lielākās apkaimes biedrības pārstāvju ikdienā, kuri Grīziņkalnā rūpējas par zaļas un labiekārtotas ārtelpas izveidi, kā arī Pierīgas novadu mājsaimniecībās, vērtējot dažādu apkures veidu efektivitāti un draudzīgumu videi, dažādu mākslinieku saimniekošanas paradumos u.c. Raidījumu vada aktrise un kostīmu māksliniece Madara Botmane, iepazīstinot ar planētai draudzīga dzīvesstila ikdienas paradumiem Latvijas kopienās, komūnās, kolektīvos, apkaimēs un vairāku paaudžu ģimeņu mājvietās.

programme.title: Spried ar Delfi
programme.desc: Katru darba dienu kopā ar dažādu nozaru speciālistiem, kā arī "Delfi" un citu mediju žurnālistiem aicinām skatītājus spriest par kādu aktuālu tematu - politiķu lēmumiem un to sekām, amatpersonu rīcību un tās motīviem, pārmaiņām sabiedrībā un tās virzītām iniciatīvām, pasaulē notiekošo un tā ietekmi uz Latviju, sasniegumiem un zaudējumiem sportā, kultūras personībām un procesiem.
